snippet.title: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business | Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order now and settle RoboCop’s Unfinished Business on July 17th: https://www.nacongaming.com/en/robocop-unfinished-business

A group of mercenaries has lit up Metro West, turning it into a shooting gallery before seizing control of the OmniTower, OCP’s latest development project on their pathway to building Delta City. 

Jump back into the metal chassis of RoboCop, make use of new weapons, fight powerful enemies, and fight your way to the top of this tower-turned-fortress in this action-packed follow-up to Rogue City.

RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business is coming to Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and PC in Summer 2025.
